verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a public REST API. Read endpoints return faults and projects, and write endpoints accept exception notices, deploy notifications, and source-map uploads. Evidence of driving the full product this way is thinner: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths 404), and no documented management endpoints were shown for actions like resolving errors or managing alarms and dashboards. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, evidence of broad management/write endpoints (e.g., resolve/assign faults, dashboards, alarms), authentication/rate-limit documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
